name: Can smart lighting systems improve home safety, and how?

mainEntity.name: Can smart lighting systems improve home safety, and how?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart lighting systems can enhance home safety in several ways. Many systems allow you to control lights remotely, creating the illusion of occupancy when you're away, which can deter potential intruders. You can also program lights to turn on automatically at dusk or when motion is detected, illuminating dark areas and reducing trip hazards. Integration with security systems can further boost safety by linking lighting responses to alarms or surveillance. While convenient, professional installation ensures they are safely wired.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smart lighting improves safety by allowing remote control for security, automatic illumination of dark areas, and integration with home security systems.
